### Set Up for Importing

All our csv files need to ensure standardised column names to avoid errors when importing - this is done using R so we gather all our csv files.

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(stringr)

csv_dir <- "/Users/julianacano/DCDM_Group_Project/Cleaned Data_Ready for DB import"
setwd(csv_dir)

bespokeTask <- read_csv("bespokeTask.csv")
Disease_information <- read_csv("Disease_information.csv")
```

The bespokeTask csv and Disease_information still have rows that have multiple variables e.g. high_level_mp_ids - MP:0005367, MP:0005369, MP:0005370, MP:0005376, MP:0005378, MP:0005384, MP:0005385, MP:0005386, MP:0005397, MP:0010768 all in one row so we want to separate this for a clean import.

```{r}

# Add a unique row ID to bespokeTask
bespokeTask <- bespokeTask %>%
  mutate(bespoke_row_id = row_number())

library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(stringr)
# Build the normalised bridge table (one row per bespoke_row_id + high_level_mp_ids)
mp_bridge <- bespokeTask %>%
  select(bespoke_row_id, high_level_mp_ids = all_of("high_level_mp_ids")) %>%
  filter(!is.na(high_level_mp_ids), str_trim(high_level_mp_ids) != "") %>%
  separate_longer_delim(high_level_mp_ids, delim = ",") %>%
  mutate(high_level_mp_ids = str_trim(high_level_mp_ids)) %>%
  filter(high_level_mp_ids != "") %>%
  distinct()

# Clean parent table without the pipe-separated column
bespokeTask <- bespokeTask %>%
  select(-all_of("high_level_mp_ids"))

# Save to our directory 

library(readr)
write_csv(mp_bridge, file.path(getwd(), "bespoke_task_mp_bridge.csv"))

write_csv(bespokeTask, file.path(getwd(), "bespoke_task_standardised.csv"))
```

Do the same but with Disease_information csv

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(stringr)

disease_information_standardised <- Disease_information %>%
  mutate(disease_row_id = row_number())

mouse_genotype_bridge <- disease_information_standardised %>%
  select(disease_row_id, mouse_genotype_ids = all_of("mouse_genotype_ids")) %>%
  filter(!is.na(mouse_genotype_ids), str_trim(mouse_genotype_ids) != "") %>%
  separate_longer_delim(mouse_genotype_ids, delim = "|") %>%
  mutate(mouse_genotype_ids = str_trim(mouse_genotype_ids)) %>%
  filter(mouse_genotype_ids != "") %>%
  distinct()

# Drop the raw pipe-separated column from the parent table before saving/importing
disease_information_standardised <- disease_information_standardised %>%
  select(-all_of("mouse_genotype_ids"))

write_csv(disease_information_standardised, file.path(getwd(), "Disease_information_standardised.csv"))

write_csv(mouse_genotype_bridge, file.path(getwd(), "mouse_genotype_bridge.csv"))
```

## Make the parameter group member csv

to know what parameter_group go with what procedure code and parameter id

```{r}

library(dplyr)
library(readr)

parameters_df <- read_csv("Parameters.csv", show_col_types = FALSE)
procedures_df <- read_csv("Procedures.csv", show_col_types = FALSE)

proc_summary <- parameters_df %>%
  left_join(procedures_df, by = "procedure_code") %>%
  group_by(procedure_code, procedure_name) %>%
  summarise(
    n_parameters = n_distinct(parameter_id),
    example_params = paste(head(unique(na.omit(parameter_name)), 4), collapse = " | "),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  arrange(procedure_code)

print(proc_summary, n = Inf)
```

here by doing this we assign what procedure codes align with which of our 6 group members

- **`1Behaviour`** (behavioural, locomotor, neuromuscular, sensory/pain, sleep, and activity tests):`ACS`, `CSD`, `ECT`, `FEA`,`FOR`, `GRS`, `HBD`, `LDT`, `OFD`, `ROT`, `SLW`, `TLS`, `VFR`, `YMZ`

- **`2Brain`** (auditory brainstem response, neuropathology/histopathology, and gross neuro/tissue pathology):`ABR`,`HIS`, `PAT`

- **`3Clinical_chemistry_and_metabolism`** (clinicalchemistry, calorimetry, glucose tolerance, insulin, plasma lipids,urinalysis):`CAL`, `CBC`, `INS`, `IPG`, `PLC`, `URI`

- **`4Haematology_and_immunophenotyping`** (haematology, immunophenotyping, autoantibodies, bone marrow/mesenteric lymph node/peripheral blood immune panels):`ANA`, `BMI`, `HEM`, `IMM`, `MLN`, `PBI`

- **`5Images`** (MicroCT, OPT, X-ray, DEXA scans, Eye Morphology, LacZ reporter imaging, and Embryo/Placenta Gross Morphology imaging):`ALZ`, `DXA`, `ELZ`, `EMA`, `EML`, `EMO`, `EOL`, `EYE`, `GEL`, `GEM`, `GEO`, `GEP`, `GPL`, `GPM`, `GPO`, `GPP`,`MAA`, `XRY`

- **`6Weight`** (body weight, organ weight, heart weight, and weight-associated load/flow tests):`BWT`, `HWT`, `LFO`, `OWT`,`PBT`

*(Note: Procedures like `BLK`, `CHL`, `ECG`, `ECH`, `EEI`, `EVL`–`EVP`, `EXD`, `FER`, `HOU`, `VIA`, `WEL`, and `NA` are experimental metadata, viability/fertility, or cardiovascular/respiratory tests that sit outside those 6 specific groups so we can leave them unassigned in `parameter_group_member`*

### Build the parameter_group_member

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(readr)
library(stringr)

parameters_df <- read_csv("Parameters.csv", show_col_types = FALSE)

# Lookup table mapping procedure_code to group_id (1-6)
proc_to_group <- tribble(
  ~procedure_code, ~group_id,
  # 1: Behaviour
  "ACS", 1L, "CSD", 1L, "ECT", 1L, "FEA", 1L, "FOR", 1L, "GRS", 1L, "HBD", 1L,
  "LDT", 1L, "OFD", 1L, "ROT", 1L, "SLW", 1L, "TLS", 1L, "VFR", 1L, "YMZ", 1L,
  
  # 2: Brain
  "ABR", 2L, "HIS", 2L, "PAT", 2L,
  
  # 3: Clinical_chemistry_and_metabolism
  "CAL", 3L, "CBC", 3L, "INS", 3L, "IPG", 3L, "PLC", 3L, "URI", 3L,
  
  # 4: Haematology_and_immunophenotyping
  "ANA", 4L, "BMI", 4L, "HEM", 4L, "IMM", 4L, "MLN", 4L, "PBI", 4L,
  
  # 5: Images
  "ALZ", 5L, "DXA", 5L, "ELZ", 5L, "EMA", 5L, "EML", 5L, "EMO", 5L, "EOL", 5L,
  "EYE", 5L, "GEL", 5L, "GEM", 5L, "GEO", 5L, "GEP", 5L, "GPL", 5L, "GPM", 5L,
  "GPO", 5L, "GPP", 5L, "MAA", 5L, "XRY", 5L,
  
  # 6: Weight
  "BWT", 6L, "HWT", 6L, "LFO", 6L, "OWT", 6L, "PBT", 6L
)

# Join to Parameters.csv to build parameter_group_member
parameter_group_member <- parameters_df %>%
  filter(!is.na(parameter_id), str_trim(parameter_id) != "") %>%
  mutate(
    parameter_id = str_trim(parameter_id),
    procedure_code = str_trim(procedure_code)
  ) %>%
  inner_join(proc_to_group, by = "procedure_code") %>%
  select(group_id, parameter_id) %>%
  distinct() %>%
  arrange(group_id, parameter_id)

# Check counts per group (1-6)
parameter_group_member %>%
  count(group_id, name = "n_parameters")

# Save to CSV in your working directory
write_csv(parameter_group_member, file.path(getwd(), "parameter_group_member.csv"))
```

# Verify that that our headers align with all our csv

```{r}
library(readr)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)

# Grab just the column names from each CSV file
header_list <- list()

for (tbl_name in names(csv_files)) {
  file_path <- file.path(getwd(), csv_files[[tbl_name]])
  cols <- names(read_csv(file_path, n_max = 0, show_col_types = FALSE))
  
  header_list[[tbl_name]] <- tibble(
    table_name = tbl_name,
    column_name = cols,
    present = "Yes"
  )
}

col_map_long <- bind_rows(header_list)

# Grid showing which columns appear in which CSVs
cross_table_map <- col_map_long %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = table_name,
    values_from = present,
    values_fill = "-"
  ) %>%
  arrange(column_name)

print(cross_table_map, n = Inf)

# Columns that show up in at least two files (potential join keys or duplicates)
shared_cols <- col_map_long %>%
  count(column_name, name = "num_files") %>%
  filter(num_files >= 2) %>%
  arrange(desc(num_files), column_name)

# Columns that only appear in one file
unique_cols <- col_map_long %>%
  add_count(column_name, name = "num_files") %>%
  filter(num_files == 1) %>%
  select(table_name, column_name) %>%
  arrange(table_name, column_name)

View(shared_cols)
View(unique_cols)

shared_cols
```

#  Create the SQL Schema

Check the headers quickly to ensure row names of the schema tables are matching

```{r}
library(readr)
library(purrr)

csv_files <- c(
  bespoke_task_mp_bridge       = "bespoke_task_mp_bridge.csv",
  bespoke_task_standardised    = "bespoke_task_standardised.csv",
  chrom2                       = "chrom2.csv",
  disease_information_std      = "Disease_information_standardised.csv",
  group14_dataset              = "Group14_Cleaned_Imputed_Dataset.csv",
  mouse_genotype_bridge        = "mouse_genotype_bridge.csv",
  parameter_group_member       = "parameter_group_member.csv",
  parameter_group              = "parameter_group.csv",
  parameters                   = "Parameters.csv",
  procedures                   = "Procedures.csv"
)
walk(csv_files, function(f) {
  cat("\n===", f, "===\n")
  print(names(read_csv(file.path(getwd(), f), n_max = 1, show_col_types = FALSE)))
})
```

## Schema script 

```{sql connection=}
CREATE DATABASE Data_base_merged
  DEFAULT CHARACTER SET utf8mb4
  DEFAULT COLLATE utf8mb4_0900_ai_ci;

USE Data_base_merged;

-- 1. Core Mouse Gene Hub Table
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS mouse_gene (
    gene_accession_id VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL,
    gene_symbol VARCHAR(64),
    PRIMARY KEY (gene_accession_id),
    INDEX idx_mouse_gene_symbol (gene_symbol)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4;

-- 2. Procedures (matches Procedures.csv)
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS procedures (
    procedure_code VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL,
    procedure_name VARCHAR(255),
    procedure_description TEXT,
    is_mandatory BOOLEAN,
    PRIMARY KEY (procedure_code)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4;

-- 3. Parameters (matches Parameters.csv)
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS parameters (
    parameter_id VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL,
    parameter_name VARCHAR(255),
    parameter_description TEXT,
    procedure_code VARCHAR(64),
    impc_parameter_orig_id VARCHAR(64),
    PRIMARY KEY (parameter_id),
    CONSTRAINT fk_param_procedure_code
        FOREIGN KEY (procedure_code)
        REFERENCES procedures (procedure_code),
    INDEX idx_param_proc_code (procedure_code),
    INDEX idx_param_orig_id (impc_parameter_orig_id)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4;

-- 4. Parameter Groups (matches parameter_group.csv)
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS parameter_group (
    group_id INT NOT NULL,
    group_name VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL,
    PRIMARY KEY (group_id),
    UNIQUE KEY uq_parameter_group_name (group_name)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4;

-- 5. Parameter Group Members (matches parameter_group_member.csv)
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS parameter_group_member (
    group_id INT NOT NULL,
    parameter_id VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL,
    PRIMARY KEY (group_id, parameter_id),
    CONSTRAINT fk_pgm_group
        FOREIGN KEY (group_id)
        REFERENCES parameter_group (group_id),
    CONSTRAINT fk_pgm_parameter
        FOREIGN KEY (parameter_id)
        REFERENCES parameters (parameter_id),
    INDEX idx_pgm_parameter (parameter_id)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4;

-- 6. Parameter Group External Scientific Resource Data
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS parameter_group_external_data (
    external_record_id BIGINT NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
    group_id INT NOT NULL,
    resource_name VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL,
    external_id VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL,
    term_or_label VARCHAR(255),
    notes TEXT,
    gene_accession_id VARCHAR(32),
    PRIMARY KEY (external_record_id),
    CONSTRAINT fk_pged_group
        FOREIGN KEY (group_id)
        REFERENCES parameter_group (group_id),
    CONSTRAINT fk_pged_mouse_gene
        FOREIGN KEY (gene_accession_id)
        REFERENCES mouse_gene (gene_accession_id),
    INDEX idx_pged_group (group_id),
    INDEX idx_pged_external (resource_name, external_id),
    INDEX idx_pged_gene (gene_accession_id)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4;

-- 7. Main Phenotyping Dataset (analysis_id as PRIMARY KEY)
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS group14_cleaned_imputed (
    analysis_id VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL,
    gene_accession_id VARCHAR(32),
    gene_symbol VARCHAR(64),
    allele_symbol VARCHAR(128),
    strain_name VARCHAR(128),
    parameter_id VARCHAR(64),
    parameter_name VARCHAR(255),
    p_value DOUBLE,
    mouse_life_stage VARCHAR(64),
    lacz_blood VARCHAR(64),
    lacz_brain VARCHAR(64),
    lacz_colon VARCHAR(64),
    lacz_eye VARCHAR(64),
    lacz_heart VARCHAR(64),
    lacz_kidney VARCHAR(64),
    lacz_liver VARCHAR(64),
    lacz_lung VARCHAR(64),
    lacz_skeletal_muscle VARCHAR(64),
    lacz_skin VARCHAR(64),
    lacz_vascular_system VARCHAR(64),
    source_file VARCHAR(255),
    PRIMARY KEY (analysis_id),
    CONSTRAINT fk_g14_mouse_gene
        FOREIGN KEY (gene_accession_id)
        REFERENCES mouse_gene (gene_accession_id),
    CONSTRAINT fk_g14_parameter
        FOREIGN KEY (parameter_id)
        REFERENCES parameters (parameter_id),
    CONSTRAINT chk_g14_pvalue
        CHECK (p_value IS NULL OR (p_value >= 0 AND p_value <= 1)),
    INDEX idx_g14_gene (gene_accession_id),
    INDEX idx_g14_param (parameter_id)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4;

-- 8. Bespoke Task Standardised
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS bespoke_task_standardised (
    bespoke_row_id BIGINT NOT NULL,
    human_gene_symbol VARCHAR(64),
    human_entrez_gene_id VARCHAR(32),
    gene_symbol VARCHAR(64),
    gene_accession_id VARCHAR(32),
    in_impc_dataset VARCHAR(32),
    PRIMARY KEY (bespoke_row_id),
    CONSTRAINT fk_bts_mouse_gene
        FOREIGN KEY (gene_accession_id)
        REFERENCES mouse_gene (gene_accession_id),
    INDEX idx_bts_gene (gene_accession_id),
    INDEX idx_bts_human_symbol (human_gene_symbol)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4;

-- 9. Bespoke Task MP Bridge
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS bespoke_task_mp_bridge (
    bespoke_row_id BIGINT NOT NULL,
    high_level_mp_ids VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL,
    PRIMARY KEY (bespoke_row_id, high_level_mp_ids),
    CONSTRAINT fk_btmp_bespoke_row
        FOREIGN KEY (bespoke_row_id)
        REFERENCES bespoke_task_standardised (bespoke_row_id),
    INDEX idx_btmp_mp_id (high_level_mp_ids)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4;

-- 10. Disease Information Standardised
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS disease_information_standardised (
    disease_row_id BIGINT NOT NULL,
    human_gene_symbol VARCHAR(64),
    human_gene_name VARCHAR(255),
    hgnc_id VARCHAR(32),
    do_term_name VARCHAR(255),
    do_term_id VARCHAR(32),
    gene_symbol VARCHAR(64),
    gene_accession_id VARCHAR(32),
    PRIMARY KEY (disease_row_id),
    CONSTRAINT fk_dis_mouse_gene
        FOREIGN KEY (gene_accession_id)
        REFERENCES mouse_gene (gene_accession_id),
    INDEX idx_dis_gene (gene_accession_id),
    INDEX idx_dis_do_term (do_term_id)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4;

-- 11. Mouse Genotype Bridge
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS mouse_genotype_bridge (
    disease_row_id BIGINT NOT NULL,
    mouse_genotype_ids VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,
    PRIMARY KEY (disease_row_id, mouse_genotype_ids),
    CONSTRAINT fk_mgb_disease_row
        FOREIGN KEY (disease_row_id)
        REFERENCES disease_information_standardised (disease_row_id),
    INDEX idx_mgb_genotype (mouse_genotype_ids)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4;

-- 12. Chromosome 2 Annotations
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS chrom2 (
    ensembl_gene_id VARCHAR(64),
    ensembl_transcript_id VARCHAR(64),
    gene_name VARCHAR(255),
    ensembl_exon_id VARCHAR(64),
    exon_start BIGINT,
    exon_end BIGINT,
    exon_rank INT,
    gene_accession_id VARCHAR(32),
    gene_symbol VARCHAR(64),
    CONSTRAINT fk_chrom2_mouse_gene
        FOREIGN KEY (gene_accession_id)
        REFERENCES mouse_gene (gene_accession_id),
    INDEX idx_chrom2_ensembl_gene (ensembl_gene_id),
    INDEX idx_chrom2_ensembl_tx (ensembl_transcript_id),
    INDEX idx_chrom2_gene_acc (gene_accession_id),
    INDEX idx_chrom2_symbol (gene_symbol)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4;
```

## Schema is complete

Lets begin to import :

## Importing the data

```{r}
library(DBI)
library(RMariaDB)
library(readr)
library(dplyr)
library(stringr)

# Connect interactively to MySQL
con <- dbConnect(
  RMariaDB::MariaDB(),
  dbname = "data_base_merged",
  host = "127.0.0.1",
  port = 3306,
  user = "root",
  password = rstudioapi::askForPassword("Enter MySQL password:")
)

dbExecute(con, "USE data_base_merged;")

# Helper to trim strings and convert empty strings to NA
clean_empty_to_na <- function(df) {
  df %>%
    mutate(across(where(is.character), ~ {
      x <- str_trim(.x)
      ifelse(is.na(x) | x == "", NA_character_, x)
    }))
}

# Read all 10 CSV files
procedures_df      <- read_csv("Procedures.csv", show_col_types = FALSE) %>% clean_empty_to_na()
parameters_df      <- read_csv("Parameters.csv", show_col_types = FALSE) %>% clean_empty_to_na()
param_group_df     <- read_csv("parameter_group.csv", show_col_types = FALSE) %>% clean_empty_to_na()
param_group_mem_df <- read_csv("parameter_group_member.csv", show_col_types = FALSE) %>% clean_empty_to_na()
g14_df             <- read_csv("Group14_Cleaned_Imputed_Dataset.csv", show_col_types = FALSE) %>% clean_empty_to_na()
bespoke_std_df     <- read_csv("bespoke_task_standardised.csv", show_col_types = FALSE) %>% clean_empty_to_na()
bespoke_mp_df      <- read_csv("bespoke_task_mp_bridge.csv", show_col_types = FALSE) %>% clean_empty_to_na()
disease_std_df     <- read_csv("Disease_information_standardised.csv", show_col_types = FALSE) %>% clean_empty_to_na()
genotype_bridge_df <- read_csv("mouse_genotype_bridge.csv", show_col_types = FALSE) %>% clean_empty_to_na()
chrom2_df          <- read_csv("chrom2.csv", show_col_types = FALSE) %>% clean_empty_to_na()

# Coerce is_mandatory cleanly for MySQL BOOLEAN
procedures_clean <- procedures_df %>%
  mutate(
    is_mandatory = case_when(
      is.logical(is_mandatory) ~ is_mandatory,
      is.numeric(is_mandatory) ~ ifelse(is.na(is_mandatory), NA, is_mandatory != 0),
      is.character(is_mandatory) ~ case_when(
        tolower(trimws(is_mandatory)) %in% c("true", "t", "1", "yes") ~ TRUE,
        tolower(trimws(is_mandatory)) %in% c("false", "f", "0", "no") ~ FALSE,
        TRUE ~ NA
      ),
      TRUE ~ NA
    )
  )


# Build and import root parent tables first
mouse_gene_df <- bind_rows(
  g14_df %>% select(gene_accession_id, gene_symbol),
  bespoke_std_df %>% select(gene_accession_id, gene_symbol),
  disease_std_df %>% select(gene_accession_id, gene_symbol),
  chrom2_df %>% select(gene_accession_id, gene_symbol)
) %>%
  filter(!is.na(gene_accession_id)) %>%
  distinct(gene_accession_id, .keep_all = TRUE)

dbWriteTable(con, "mouse_gene", mouse_gene_df, append = TRUE, row.names = FALSE)
dbWriteTable(con, "procedures", procedures_clean, append = TRUE, row.names = FALSE)
dbWriteTable(con, "parameter_group", param_group_df, append = TRUE, row.names = FALSE)

# 6. Check for any orphan foreign keys before writing child tables
orphan_checks <- list(
  orphan_proc_in_params = setdiff(
    na.omit(unique(tolower(trimws(parameters_df$procedure_code)))),
    na.omit(unique(tolower(trimws(procedures_clean$procedure_code))))
  ),
  orphan_param_in_pgm = setdiff(
    na.omit(unique(tolower(trimws(param_group_mem_df$parameter_id)))),
    na.omit(unique(tolower(trimws(parameters_df$parameter_id))))
  ),
  orphan_param_in_g14 = setdiff(
    na.omit(unique(tolower(trimws(g14_df$parameter_id)))),
    na.omit(unique(tolower(trimws(parameters_df$parameter_id))))
  ),
  orphan_bespoke_ids = setdiff(
    na.omit(unique(bespoke_mp_df$bespoke_row_id)),
    na.omit(unique(bespoke_std_df$bespoke_row_id))
  ),
  orphan_disease_ids = setdiff(
    na.omit(unique(genotype_bridge_df$disease_row_id)),
    na.omit(unique(disease_std_df$disease_row_id))
  )
)
print(orphan_checks)
# so this means there are zero missing parent records 



# Import child and bridge tables in strict dependency order
dbWriteTable(con, "parameters", parameters_df, append = TRUE, row.names = FALSE)
dbWriteTable(con, "parameter_group_member", param_group_mem_df, append = TRUE, row.names = FALSE)
dbWriteTable(con, "group14_cleaned_imputed", g14_df, append = TRUE, row.names = FALSE)
dbWriteTable(con, "bespoke_task_standardised", bespoke_std_df, append = TRUE, row.names = FALSE)
dbWriteTable(con, "bespoke_task_mp_bridge", bespoke_mp_df, append = TRUE, row.names = FALSE)
dbWriteTable(con, "disease_information_standardised", disease_std_df, append = TRUE, row.names = FALSE)
dbWriteTable(con, "mouse_genotype_bridge", genotype_bridge_df, append = TRUE, row.names = FALSE)
dbWriteTable(con, "chrom2", chrom2_df, append = TRUE, row.names = FALSE)

# Verify exact row counts across all schema tables
tables_to_check <- c(
  "mouse_gene",
  "procedures",
  "parameters",
  "parameter_group",
```
